detect.note: Emerald Legacy keeps Emerald's signature and sections, so an Emerald save can pass too. The Pokédex's seen flags, which agree at Legacy's offsets and not at Emerald's, and the counts in its pockets tell it apart. Imperium's checksums and Heart & Soul's magic rule out the saves those formats claim first.

note: Emerald Legacy is Emerald with three constants changed: 120 slots in the items pocket, 96 more trainer flags and one more event variable. SaveBlock1 grows to 0x3D98 bytes, so everything after the items pocket moves. SaveBlock2, the boxes and the Pokémon are Emerald's, and so are the species, item and move indexes. 1.x covers V1.0.0 to V1.1.4, which keep this save.
